requirements.quote: min_rtt MUST be set to the latest_rtt on the first RTT sample.
requirements.condition: When the sender obtains the first RTT sample for the path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not initialize min_rtt to a value other than latest_rtt or leave it unset.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the first RTT sample and inspect whether min_rtt exactly equals latest_rtt afterward.

requirements.quote:
min_rtt MUST be set to the lesser of min_rtt and latest_rtt
   (Section 5.1) on all other samples.
requirements.condition: On any RTT sample after the first when latest_rtt is less than the current min_rtt.
requirements.required_behavior: Set min_rtt equal to latest_rtt for that sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not retain the larger prior min_rtt or set min_rtt to any other value.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject a later RTT sample below the stored minimum and verify that min_rtt decreases to that exact sample value.

requirements.quote:
min_rtt MUST be set to the lesser of min_rtt and latest_rtt
   (Section 5.1) on all other samples.
requirements.condition: On any RTT sample after the first when latest_rtt is greater than or equal to the current min_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not increase min_rtt to the larger latest_rtt or change it to another value.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inject an equal or larger later RTT sample and verify that the stored min_rtt remains unchanged.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint uses only locally observed times in computing the min_rtt
   and does not adjust for acknowledgment delays reported by the peer.
requirements.condition: When computing min_rtt from an RTT observation.
requirements.required_behavior: Use only times observed locally by the endpoint.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not incorporate peer-originated timing values into the min_rtt computation.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can hold local send and receive times constant while varying peer-provided timing data and verify that the min_rtt result is unchanged.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint uses only locally observed times in computing the min_rtt
   and does not adjust for acknowledgment delays reported by the peer.
requirements.condition: When a peer reports an acknowledgment delay for an RTT sample used in min_rtt computation.
requirements.required_behavior: Compute min_rtt without subtracting or otherwise applying the reported acknowledgment delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not adjust min_rtt for the peer-reported acknowledgment delay.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can vary the reported acknowledgment delay for identical locally observed timing and verify that min_rtt does not vary with it.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints SHOULD set the min_rtt to the newest RTT sample after
   persistent congestion is established.
requirements.condition: After persistent congestion has been established.
requirements.required_behavior: Set min_rtt to the newest RTT sample.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not ordinarily retain the pre-congestion min_rtt instead of resetting it to the newest sample.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish persistent congestion with a newest RTT sample distinct from the stored minimum and inspect the resulting min_rtt.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints MAY reestablish the min_rtt at other times in the
   connection, such as when traffic volume is low and an acknowledgment
   is received with a low acknowledgment delay.
requirements.condition: At other times in the connection, including the illustrative case of low traffic volume and receipt of an acknowledgment with a low acknowledgment delay.
requirements.required_behavior: An endpoint is permitted, but not required, to reestablish min_rtt.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: No implementation behavior is forbidden by this permission.
requirements.why_checkable: The statement permits an optional action and provides only an example trigger, so it does not create a mandatory implementation outcome that can be tested for conformance.

requirements.quote:
Implementations SHOULD
   NOT refresh the min_rtt value too often since the actual minimum RTT
   of the path is not frequently observable.
requirements.condition: When deciding whether to refresh min_rtt during the connection.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not refresh min_rtt too often.
requirements.why_checkable: The text defines neither a refresh-frequency threshold nor a measurement window, so 'too often' cannot be evaluated objectively from this chunk.
